'''Spiced Cannok Canapes''' were a flavorful type of [[Canapé/Legends|canapé]] developed by [[Napo Popotis]], a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] from<ref name="Cookbook" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Like most of Popotis's most famous creations, the canapés were made from a local animal&mdash;the [[cannok]],<ref name="Cookbook" /> which was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Onderon's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spiced Cannok Canapes were mentioned in the "Delicacies from the Demon Moon" Codex entry in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']], the [[2019]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Cookbook" />
